Tempo Storm was an American esports organization. They have hosted Counter-Strike: Global Offensive teams from North America, Brazil and Europe.

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2015
  • 2016
  • 2017
  • 2018
  • Show All
  • March 31st - Tempo Storm sign Ascendancy, a lineup consisting of: ryx, stanislaw, Assailant, glorinsz and sLip. [1]
  • April 23rd - Tempo Storm part ways with Assailant and sign hades as his replacement. [2]
  • May 11th - Tempo Storm part ways with sLip and sign ShahZaM as his replacement. [3]
  • June 22nd - Tempo Storm part ways with hades. [4]
  • June 27th - Tempo Storm part ways with glorinsz. [5]
  • June 30th - Tempo Storm sign roca, RUSH and Warden, the latter as coach. [6]
  • July 8th - RUSH is acquired by eLevate. [7]
  • July 11th - Tempo Storm sign autimatic to complete their lineup. [8]
  • August 11th - Tempo Storm part ways with autimatic and roca. [9]
  • August 13th - Tempo Storm part ways with their lineup. [10]
  • February 10th - Tempo Storm sign the roster of Games Academy consisting of HEN1, LUCAS1, SHOOWTiME, felps, boltz and peacemaker, the latter as coach. [11]
  • May 11th - Tempo Storm part ways with peacemaker. [12]
  • May 28th - Tempo Storm sign zakk as their new coach. [13]
  • June 1st - Tempo Storm' roster is acquired by Immortals. [14]
  • August 11th - Tempo Storm sign ex-paiN Gaming, a lineup consisting of land1n, tatazin, dzt, shz and destiny. [15]
  • October 10th - Tempo Storm sign s1 as destiny is acquired by Immortals. [16][17]
  • November 7th - shz is acquired by Immortals. [18]
  • November 9th - Tempo Storm sign YJ to complete their lineup. [19]
  • November 20th - YJ is acquired by W7M Gaming. [20]
  • December 21st - Tempo Storm part ways with s1 as they re-acquire destiny and shz from Immortals. [21]
  • February 20th - destiny is acquired by Virtue Gaming. [22]
  • February 22nd - Tempo Storm part ways with their lineup. [23]
  • May 3rd - Tempo Storm sign a new lineup consisting of fox, HS, innocent, loWel, SOKER and dracU, the latter as coach. [24]
  • May 28th - Tempo Storm part ways with dracU due to him being associated with multiple VAC banned accounts. [25]
  • June 3rd - Tempo Storm part ways with SOKER and sign cheti as his replacement. [26]
  • July 19th - loWel is acquired by Movistar Riders. [27]
  • September 3rd - Tempo Storm part ways with fox. [28]
  • December 10th - Tempo Storm release innocent and HS by mutual agreement. [29][30]
